summary: This bill disapproves a final rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency regarding the regulation of Trichloroethylene (TCE) under the Toxic Substances Control Act, preventing it from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves an EPA rule regulating Trichloroethylene (TCE) under the Toxic Substances Control Act. By nullifying this regulation, the bill would lead to less environmental protection regarding this specific toxic substance, which is a central aim of the bill.
